table.name: mageos_ai_usage_log
table.comment: Per-call AI token usage: counts and metadata only, never prompt or response content

column.name: entity_id
column.comment: Primary key

column.name: service_id
column.comment: AiServiceInterface::getId() row key; an opaque JSON object key, never treat as an integer

column.name: service_code
column.comment: AiServiceConfigurationInterface::getCode() of the backend that served the call

column.name: model
column.comment: Model name reported by the provider

column.name: consumer
column.comment: Identifier of the module or skill that made the call

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store the call ran under; not null, defaults to the admin store (0). No FK to store: deleting a store must not silently erase historical accounting

column.name: input_tokens
column.comment: Prompt tokens

column.name: output_tokens
column.comment: Completion tokens

column.name: total_tokens
column.comment: Total tokens; provider-reported total, or prompt plus completion when the provider reported none

column.name: cached_tokens
column.comment: Cached portion of the prompt tokens, when the provider reports prompt caching separately

column.name: reasoning_tokens
column.comment: Reasoning portion of the completion tokens, when the provider reports thinking tokens separately

column.name: streamed
column.comment: Whether the call was served over a streaming response

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Timestamp written by the database. Day boundaries are computed in PHP from TimezoneInterface and applied as half-open created_at >= start AND created_at < end ranges; never DATE(created_at) or CONVERT_TZ(), the MySQL timezone tables are not guaranteed to be loaded on a customer install

table.name: mageos_ai_usage_daily
table.comment: Daily roll-up of AI token usage the cron writes before pruning mageos_ai_usage_log; counts and metadata only, never prompt or response content

column.name: entity_id
column.comment: Primary key

column.name: usage_date
column.comment: Store-timezone date the roll-up computed for this row, from TimezoneInterface; not DATE(created_at) and not a UTC date

column.name: service_id
column.comment: AiServiceInterface::getId() row key; an opaque JSON object key, never treat as an integer

column.name: service_code
column.comment: AiServiceConfigurationInterface::getCode() of the backend that served the calls; derivable from service_id, kept out of the unique key

column.name: model
column.comment: Model name reported by the provider

column.name: consumer
column.comment: Identifier of the module or skill that made the calls

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store the calls ran under; not null, defaults to the admin store (0). No FK to store: deleting a store must not silently erase historical accounting

column.name: calls
column.comment: Number of calls rolled up into this row

column.name: input_tokens
column.comment: Prompt tokens

column.name: output_tokens
column.comment: Completion tokens

column.name: total_tokens
column.comment: Total tokens; provider-reported total, or prompt plus completion when the provider reported none

column.name: cached_tokens
column.comment: Cached portion of the prompt tokens, when the provider reports prompt caching separately

column.name: reasoning_tokens
column.comment: Reasoning portion of the completion tokens, when the provider reports thinking tokens separately
